answer: In Proof of Agent, identity verification binds each node to a Wesolowski VDF whose proof requires a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings. Although verification is fast, generating valid output demands elapsed wall-clock time, so cloning one identity into many agents does not yield parallel progress: GPUs cannot safely split the dependency chain. This physical bottleneck makes quartz, signal, and vertex identities costly to multiply, strengthening Sybil resistance.
